messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - GPU pool "hot-rt" approaching capacity, queue growth observed, autoscaler not adding nodes. Triggered by repeated throttles at 11:07 UTC. Metrics: queue_length=4200, p95_latency_tokens=320ms, pool_util=98%
Elaine (SRE): I'm on it. pulling up autoscaler logs and recent config rollouts. anyone oncall for infra? @Priya
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'm here. seeing a recent rollout 11:00 UTC that changed continuous batching params and prefix-cache TTL. suspect regression.
Matt L: saw spikes in batching wait times in traces, tasks are waiting for batch window to fill then timing out and falling back to small batches. that increases per-request GPU cost and lowers throughput.
Ivy (ML Infra): digging into prefix cache hits. preliminary: prefix_cache_hit_rate dropped from 94% -> 12% after rollout. prefix-cache key hashing change?
Sam (Support): we have 3 enterprise customers reporting timeouts and elevated errors. CS ticket ids: #C-812, #C-814. customers are affected by high latency.
Elaine (SRE): can we temporarily open scale cap for hot-rt pool? current autoscaler limit is 40 nodes, usage at 39. need +10 to buy time. Priya can we override?
Priya (Eng-Platform): We can append emergency override. running: `./infractl pools update hot-rt --max-nodes 50 --reason "live incident override"`
deploy-bot: deploy job queued: infractl v2.3.1 -> pools/hot-rt:max_nodes = 50.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: succeed - change applied (job 6789) at 11:18 UTC
Matt L: good. queue length dropped a bit but still high. looks like throughput still degraded. batches smaller, GPU kernels underutilized.
Ivy (ML Infra): confirmed prefix-cache miss flood is the dominant issue. root cause: rollout changed prefix cache key canonicalization (strip_trailing_newline=false -> true). old requests keyed with trailing newline now miss. patch introduced in PR 8421 at 11:00.
Elaine (SRE): can we rollback PR 8421? Priya, what's the plan for safe rollback?
Priya (Eng-Platform): we can revert that config at the control plane without model restarts. running: `kubectl patch configmap inference-config -n redwood --type merge -p '{"data":{"prefix_cache.canonicalize":"strip_trailing_newline=false"}}'`
Elaine (SRE): post the exact command and I'll run it. include a short window to observe.
Priya (Eng-Platform): executing now.
Ivy (ML Infra): rolling back. watching cache warmup. prefix cache hit rate starting to climb: 12% -> 48% in 90s.
Matt L: batch sizes climbing back up, avg_batch_size went 1.3 -> 5.8. GPU utilization increasing.
Sam (Support): customers reporting partial recovery on C-812 and C-814. reducing error rate. I'll update tickets and let customers know we have mitigation in place. :thumbsup:
Elaine (SRE): great. still seeing some autoscaler jitter. we should adjust continuous batching params to reduce dependence on single key canonicalization. I'm going to pin a conservative batch window and max_latency to limit tiny-batch fallbacks. proposing: `request_batch_window_ms=30`, `max_batch_latency_ms=60`. anyone object?
Matt L: fine with that. reduces latency while allowing decent batching.
Ivy (ML Infra): also recommend adding a cache-compatibility test in rollout gating: verify prefix cache hit parity vs baseline on sampling traffic.
Priya (Eng-Platform): applied conservative batching override via control plane. command: `infractl continuous-batching set hot-rt --batch_window_ms=30 --max_latency_ms=60 --reason "incident temporary conservative defaults"`
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: applied continuous-batching override (job 6790) at 11:26 UTC
Elaine (SRE): monitoring. p95 latency tokens down from 320ms -> 180ms over 3 mins. queue_length trending down to 900.
Ivy (ML Infra): prefix_cache_hit_rate back to 91% after warmup steady-state. looks stable.
Sam (Support): customers confirm recovery. updating tickets, asking about RCA ETA.
Elaine (SRE): rolling this to next oncall. I'm going offline in 20m. Priya, please keep the emergency max-nodes override until we confirm no flare-ups. we'll coordinate a controlled redeploy for the canonicalization fix tomorrow with canary gating.
Priya (Eng-Platform): understood. keeping override until 15:00 UTC tomorrow unless lifted earlier.
Matt L: action items: 1) revert PR 8421 permanent fix + add unit/test for trailing newline canonicalization. 2) add cache parity check to rollout pipeline. 3) add continuous-batching config e2e that simulates prefix cache misses.
Ivy (ML Infra): I'll own (1) and (3). estimated ETA EOD tomorrow for a safe canary.
Elaine (SRE): I'll open the incident ticket and severity assessment. preliminary customer impact: 3 enterprise customers impacted intermittently, some increased tail latency and timeouts. severity: SEV2.
Sam (Support): I'll prepare customer-facing note and sync with account owners.
Elaine (SRE): handing off to Priya for live monitoring and rollback watch. leaving detailed notes below. next oncall: @Priya - will take lead.
Priya (Eng-Platform): taking handoff. I'll post hourly updates and escalate if queue > 1500 or p95 > 250ms.
pagerbot: Reminder: on-call rotation change via /pager handoff executed.
Elaine (SRE): thanks team. postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (prefix canonicalization regression), mitigation (rollback + batch overrides + emergency scale cap), follow-ups (tests + pipeline gating). I'll assign owners in the incident doc.
Sam (Support): adding CS notes and customer comms drafts to the incident doc.
Priya (Eng-Platform): closing note: keeping hot-rt max nodes=50, continuous-batching conservative override, monitoring cache hit parity. will lift overrides after canary deploy tomorrow and confirmation of stable hit rates.
Elaine (SRE): closing thread for now. please ping if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
